info.title: HMS API: PROPOSED additions (draft)
info.description: PROPOSED contract, written by the frontend, for routes that docs/HMS Frontend Integration Handoff.md (8.2, 8.10, 8.12) names but docs/openapi.json does not define: expense categories, bank accounts and audit entries (Item History). The backend is to be built to match this file exactly; any difference must be reported to the frontend before it ships. Same conventions as openapi.json: ULID ids, money as strings, ISO 8601 UTC instants, one ErrorResponse envelope. Not served by any backend yet.

get.description:
**Access:** Requires permission: `audit.read`.

Newest first (`occurredAt` descending, ties by `id` descending). Read-only. `entityType` is the kind of record, `entityId` its id (for `doctor` the doctor's user id; for `clinic_settings` the hospital's id from `GET /api/v1/auth/me`). A record that does not exist in this hospital answers `404 NOT_FOUND`.

message.description: For humans. May be reworded between releases.
message.example: You do not have permission to do this.

details.description: Present for validation failures (`[{ path, message }]`) and for errors carrying context, e.g. `{ retryAfterSeconds }` or `{ problems }`.

name.description: Trimmed. Unique in the hospital, ignoring case.

accountNo.description: Letters, digits, spaces and hyphens (an IBAN or a local number). Unique in the hospital, ignoring case and spaces.

AuditChangeDto.description: A scalar (string, number, boolean) or null. Money is a decimal string. A value that is a list or an object (for example a lab test's parameters) is sent as a short text summary such as `3 parameters`: the frontend renders every value as plain text.

actor.description: `null` for a change the system made; the frontend shows "System".

changes.description: For `updated`: one entry per changed field, keyed by the API's field name (for example `rate`, `name`, `phone`). `null` for `created`, `deactivated` and `reactivated`. Secrets (passwords, temporary passwords, tokens) never appear.
